_public_detail_text:
GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE 

June 9, 2026 Carolyn M. Story - Liaison

Manager's Report - Megan stated that the monthly income for the end of the season was $1,257. The new color for the 2025-2026 golf membership sticker is purple.

Caroline Zimmerman reported that the purpose of this meeting was to develop a Code of Conduct. The USGA standards of player conduct were referenced.

Motion was made to develop a Code of Conduct.

Discussion regarding penalties ensued. Add penalties to the Code of Conduct to address violators, play with no pay, repeat violators, and residents' responsibility for non-paying guests.

Motion was made to develop violations and penalties. To address issues initially and for further problems to be escalated through a process starting with the Golf Advisory Committee, Rules & Regulations, and Resource Management.

Motion was made that Players must sign in the book EVERY time a round is played.

Article in the July LINK "A Healthier You - Through Golf at Palm Hill". Anyone interested in writing a golf related article for the LIN please contact Caroline Zimmerman.

Megan stated that residents should reach out to their insurance regarding reimbursement to use the medical/wellness card to pay for their golf membership fee.

Next meeting September 8, 2026. That concludes my concise report for this month.
